policy: Every requirement below is bound to a verbatim excerpt from the SIRI page named in source_roles. Nothing is paraphrased into an excerpt and nothing is inferred. No excerpt text was typed: each is resolved from LINE NUMBERS out of a numbered dump by scripts/visa-registry/excerpts-from-lines.mjs, which fails the file unless both the display and lowercase forms occur literally in the normalized text.
structure_note:
This scheme looks like the Pay Limit Scheme and is not. Two conditions belong to it alone.

THE EMPLOYER'S APPRENTICESHIP OBLIGATION. A permit under this list requires that the EMPLOYER has met its training obligations under Læreplads-AUB — a condition about the company, not the applicant, which the applicant cannot satisfy and usually cannot see. The authority states in its own FAQ that no exemption is possible. An applicant who reads only the job-title list will not know their application depends on their employer's apprenticeship record.

THERE IS NO PAY LIMIT. Salary is assessed against Danmarks Statistik wage statistics for the occupation, not against a published threshold, and the authority states that compliance with a collective agreement does NOT automatically make the terms equivalent to Danish standards. Anyone carrying the DKK 552,000 figure across from the Pay Limit Scheme would have the wrong test entirely.
freshness_note: No dateline. The body names 'Wage statistics for the Positive List for Skilled Work valid from 1 August 2026' and states that the list itself is updated twice a year, on 1 January and 1 July, so both moving parts carry their own dates in the text and a revision is visible as a text change.
not_extracted: The list of job titles itself — roughly 160 occupations with DISCO-08 codes, spanning lines 44 to 204 of the page. It is data rather than requirement, it is rewritten twice a year, and a copy of it here would be stale within six months while looking authoritative. The requirement that the job appear on the list IS extracted, and it links to the authority's own list.
The wage statistics table the salary test is measured against, which the authority publishes as a separate linked document.
The step-by-step portal walkthrough and the document checklists.
The rules for accompanying family members, which are a separate route.

requirements.label: The job must be included in the Positive List for Skilled Work
requirements.description: The defining condition, quoted with the authority's own note that others follow.
requirements.source_excerpt: your job must be included in the positive list for skilled work. in addition, there are a number of other conditions.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your job must be included in the Positive List for Skilled Work. In addition, there are a number of other conditions.

requirements.label: The list is updated twice a year — 1 January and 1 July
requirements.description: A job on the list today may not be on it at the next revision.
requirements.source_excerpt: the positive list for skilled work is updated twice a year – 1 january and 1 july.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The Positive List for Skilled Work is updated twice a year – 1 January and 1 July.

requirements.label: Salary and terms of employment must correspond to Danish standards
requirements.description: The salary test for this route. There is no published pay threshold.
requirements.source_excerpt: your salary and terms of employment must correspond to danish standards. this means that your salary, holiday entitlements and terms of notice etc. must not be inferior to the standards in the professional field where you are going to work.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your salary and terms of employment must correspond to Danish standards. This means that your salary, holiday entitlements and terms of notice etc. must not be inferior to the standards in the professional field where you are going to work.

requirements.label: Salary is assessed against Danmarks Statistik wage statistics for the occupation
requirements.description: Names the actual benchmark, which is not a fixed figure.
requirements.source_excerpt: siri applies statistics based on danmarks statistik’s wage register as a guideline to assess whether the offered salary – in your application under the positive list for skilled work – corresponds to danish standards.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: SIRI applies statistics based on Danmarks Statistik’s wage register as a guideline to assess whether the offered salary – in your application under the Positive List for Skilled Work – corresponds to Danish standards.

requirements.label: Complying with a collective agreement does NOT automatically satisfy Danish standards
requirements.description: The assumption most likely to lose an application, contradicted by the authority in its own words.
requirements.source_excerpt: even if it is stated in the application that the employment is compliant to the applicable collective agreement, the employment conditions will not automatically be considered as equivalent to danish standards.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Even if it is stated in the application that the employment is compliant to the applicable collective agreement, the employment conditions will not automatically be considered as equivalent to Danish standards.

requirements.label: The employer must have met its apprenticeship training obligations under Læreplads-AUB
requirements.description: A condition on the employer, not the applicant. Quoted with the sentence that introduces the two alternative tests.
requirements.source_excerpt: in order to be granted a residence permit based on the positive list for skilled work, it is a condition that your employer has met their educational obligations regarding training of apprentices. thus, your employer must be covered by læreplads-aub (arbejdsgivernes uddannelsesbidrag).
requirements.source_excerpt_display: In order to be granted a residence permit based on the Positive List for Skilled Work, it is a condition that your employer has met their educational obligations regarding training of apprentices. Thus, your employer must be covered by Læreplads-AUB (Arbejdsgivernes Uddannelsesbidrag).

requirements.label: The two ways the employer can meet the training target
requirements.description: Both branches quoted together with the 'Or' between them, because either alone would misstate the test.
requirements.source_excerpt:
in addition to this, at the time of the submission of the application your employer must:

have reached the target number of trained apprentices that your employer has been required to train by læreplads-aub, in the latest calculated contribution year. you employer must also not have been required to pay additional contribution (merbidrag), which is an amount employers are required to pay, if they do not reach the target number, in the latest calculated contribution year. at present, the latest calculated contribution year is 2025.

or

have reached the target number of trained apprentices that your employer has been required to train by læreplads-aub, in two out of the latest three calculated contribution years. you employer must also not have been required to pay additional contribution (merbidrag), which is an amount employers are required to pay, if they do not reach the target number, in two out of the latest three calculated contribution years. at present, the three latest calculated contribution years is 2023, 2024, and 2025.
requirements.source_excerpt_display:
In addition to this, at the time of the submission of the application your employer must:

have reached the target number of trained apprentices that your employer has been required to train by Læreplads-AUB, in the latest calculated contribution year. You employer must also not have been required to pay additional contribution (merbidrag), which is an amount employers are required to pay, if they do not reach the target number, in the latest calculated contribution year. At present, the latest calculated contribution year is 2025.

Or

have reached the target number of trained apprentices that your employer has been required to train by Læreplads-AUB, in two out of the latest three calculated contribution years. You employer must also not have been required to pay additional contribution (merbidrag), which is an amount employers are required to pay, if they do not reach the target number, in two out of the latest three calculated contribution years. At present, the three latest calculated contribution years is 2023, 2024, and 2025.

requirements.label: No exemption is possible from the employer's training obligation
requirements.description: The authority's own answer in its FAQ. Without it, a partially-compliant employer reads as an argument worth making.
requirements.source_excerpt: my employer only partially fulfills their educational obligations. is it possible to make an exemption from this requirement? it is not possible to make exemptions from this requirement, when applying under the positive list for skilled work.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: My employer only partially fulfills their educational obligations. Is it possible to make an exemption from this requirement? It is not possible to make exemptions from this requirement, when applying under the Positive List for Skilled Work.

requirements.label: Salary must be paid into a Danish bank account in your own name
requirements.source_excerpt: your salary must be paid into a danish bank account in your own name, and the bank has to be operating legally in denmark.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your salary must be paid into a Danish bank account in your own name, and the bank has to be operating legally in Denmark.

requirements.label: The Danish bank account must be opened within 180 days
requirements.source_excerpt: your danish bank account must be opened within 180 days of your residence and work permit being granted. if you enter denmark after you have been granted a residence and work permit, you must open a danish bank account within 180 days from your entry into denmark. if you already hold a danish residence permit that is valid for at least 180 days, your salary must be paid into your danish bank account from your first salary payment.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your Danish bank account must be opened within 180 days of your residence and work permit being granted. If you enter Denmark after you have been granted a residence and work permit, you must open a Danish bank account within 180 days from your entry into Denmark. If you already hold a Danish residence permit that is valid for at least 180 days, your salary must be paid into your Danish bank account from your first salary payment.

requirements.label: Salary may consist only of liquid assets, labour-market pension payments and paid holiday allowance
requirements.source_excerpt:
your salary can only consist of:

salary in the form of liquid assets

payments to labour market pension schemes

paid holiday allowance
requirements.source_excerpt_display:
Your salary can only consist of:

Salary in the form of liquid assets

Payments to labour market pension schemes

Paid holiday allowance

requirements.label: Housing, per diems, car, phone, internet, benefits-in-kind and subscriptions do not count
requirements.description: Quoted through the authority's own closing caveat that the list is not complete — dropping that line would present an exhaustive list the authority declined to give.
requirements.source_excerpt:
salary components like the following cannot be taken into account when assessing the wage level:

•paid living and housing expenses

•per diems

•free use of car

•paid phone

•paid internet

•benefits-in-kind

•subscriptions

•other services offered to you by your employer.

the list is not complete.
requirements.source_excerpt_display:
Salary components like the following cannot be taken into account when assessing the wage level:

•Paid living and housing expenses

•Per diems

•Free use of car

•Paid phone

•Paid internet

•Benefits-in-kind

•Subscriptions

•Other services offered to you by your employer.

The list is not complete.

requirements.label: An accompanying family member must not have had a permit revoked more than once for lacking a work permit
requirements.source_excerpt: one of the conditions for a residence permit under this scheme is that an accompanying family member (spouse, cohabiting partner, children or in certain circumstances other family members) has not had its residence permit revoked more than once due to lack of a required work permit.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: One of the conditions for a residence permit under this scheme is that an accompanying family member (spouse, cohabiting partner, children or in certain circumstances other family members) has not had its residence permit revoked more than once due to lack of a required work permit.

requirements.label: One month before starting work — but only if you declare you can support yourself
requirements.source_excerpt: if you apply from abroad, you can be granted a residence permit valid for 1 month before you start working. it will give you the time to settle in denmark. when you apply, you must declare that you can support yourself and any accompanying family members during this time. if you do not declare this, your residence permit will be valid for 14 days before you start working.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: If you apply from abroad, you can be granted a residence permit valid for 1 month before you start working. It will give you the time to settle in Denmark. When you apply, you must declare that you can support yourself and any accompanying family members during this time. If you do not declare this, your residence permit will be valid for 14 days before you start working.

requirements.label: Permit length follows the employment, capped at four years
requirements.source_excerpt:
if you are employed for a shorter period than 4 years, your residence and work permit will normally be valid for the period of your employment.

if your employment is for a period of 4 years or more, you will normally be granted a permit valid for 4 years.
requirements.source_excerpt_display:
If you are employed for a shorter period than 4 years, your residence and work permit will normally be valid for the period of your employment.

If your employment is for a period of 4 years or more, you will normally be granted a permit valid for 4 years.

requirements.label: A residence permit can only be valid until 3 months before the passport expires
requirements.source_excerpt: a residence permit can only be valid until 3 months before the expiry date of your passport.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: A residence permit can only be valid until 3 months before the expiry date of your passport.

requirements.label: Losing the job revokes the permit
requirements.source_excerpt: you must inform siri if you lose your job. your residence and work permit will be revoked as it is based on this exact job.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: You must inform SIRI if you lose your job. Your residence and work permit will be revoked as it is based on this exact job.

requirements.label: The work permit is limited to the employment it was granted for
requirements.description: Unlike the Pay Limit Scheme, a new position within the SAME company also needs a new permit.
requirements.source_excerpt: your work permit is limited to the employment that is the basis for your permit. you are not allowed to work in other positions than the one stated in your permit.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your work permit is limited to the employment that is the basis for your permit. You are not allowed to work in other positions than the one stated in your permit.

requirements.label: A new job — including a new position at the same company — requires a new permit
requirements.source_excerpt: if you are offered a new job, you must apply for a new permit. this also applies if you are offered a new position within the same company.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: If you are offered a new job, you must apply for a new permit. This also applies if you are offered a new position within the same company.

requirements.label: A sideline job requires a separate permit
requirements.source_excerpt: if you wish to take a sideline job, you have to obtain a separate permit.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: If you wish to take a sideline job, you have to obtain a separate permit.

requirements.label: You must support yourself and may not receive benefits under the Active Social Policy Act
requirements.source_excerpt: you must be able to support yourself and your family during your stay. for instance, you are not allowed to receive benefits under the terms of the active social policy act – and there might be other benefits that you cannot receive.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: You must be able to support yourself and your family during your stay. For instance, you are not allowed to receive benefits under the terms of the Active Social Policy Act – and there might be other benefits that you cannot receive.

requirements.label: Giving up your Danish address or staying abroad over 6 successive months lapses the permit
requirements.source_excerpt: you must not give up your danish address or stay abroad for longer than 6 successive months. a violation will result in the lapse of your permit. this means that you will lose your right to stay in denmark.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: You must not give up your Danish address or stay abroad for longer than 6 successive months. A violation will result in the lapse of your permit. This means that you will lose your right to stay in Denmark.

requirements.label: A copy of the employment contract or job offer must be attached, stating all terms
requirements.source_excerpt: when you apply, you must attach a copy of your employment contract or job offer. all terms of employment must be stated in the contract or the job offer.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: When you apply, you must attach a copy of your employment contract or job offer. All terms of employment must be stated in the contract or the job offer.
